newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's to frank divs at end 96/97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's to frank divs at end 96/97.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday it expected to start franking dividends towards the end of the current year to June 30, 1997.
"We expect to be paying tax in ... this fiscal year," Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel told a news conference.

"We do not expect to be paying a franked dividend in the half, but we will look at our franking credits towards the final dividend and we will reassess our position, it's at or around that time we are moving into franking of our dividend," Kunkel said.
Recipients of franked dividends receive tax credits for the corporation tax already paid by the companies involved.

Foster's earlier reported a two percent rise in net profit to A$293.3 million for the year to June 30, which exceeded the average market forecast for a pre-abnormal net profit of around A$270 million.
Foster's paid tax of A$8.5 million in 1996/97 on pre-tax earnings of A$302 million, having paid A$21.5 million in 1994/95 on earnings of A$367.3 million.
Foster's accumulated tax losses built up in the late 1980s and early 1990s are expected to be exhausted in the current 1996/97 year.
